name: Bring your own device (BYOD)
short_description: Bring your own device (BYOD) is the practice of employees using personally owned phones, tablets or laptops for work, which requires separating and protecting corporate data on those devices.

evidence.quote: For personal devices, what people call BYOD or bring your own device
Then there's BYOD, bring your own device. Lots of companies let employees use their personal laptops, phones or tablets.
